query: So how do I tell on people who are being naughty in the woods?
reference_answer:
Reporting Illegal Tourism Activities in Forest Areas:
Contact the Tamil Nadu Forest Department or local police station to report illegal tourism activities. Provide details of the activity, location, and any evidence. You can also call the forest department's helpline or submit a complaint online through the official website.
answer: To spot someone being naughty in the woods, look for signs like overturned rocks, broken branches, or tracks that don't match the terrain. [System]
